TOP ตู้ (ลูกค้า)
Box 440 × 440 × 740 stands on the floor between the four posts, centred.
Every face is 80 in from the post line: 56 clear of the tubes, 51 clear of the ring fittings at the corners.
The 0.60 bars (460 and 660) run outside the box faces, so the box passes them; it stops 20 under the top at 760.
The service door is in the back panel, its top at 420, under the 460 bar (tube underside 436).
